title: Distance to L*(a) is at most √(m+2)·κ(r(y)) for an integer translate y of x (Claim C)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and a ∈ Euclid P with |a_i − 1/2| < 1/4 for all i. Let κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ be such that for every u there is a finset s with m + 2 ≤ |s| and u_i ≤ κ(u) for all i ∈ s. For y ∈ Euclid P, r(y) denotes the function j ↦ r_j(y) := max((y_j − a_j)/(1 − a_j), (a_j − y_j)/a_j) (= (y_j − a_j)/(1 − a_j) if y_j ≥ a_j, and = (a_j − y_j)/a_j if y_j < a_j). Let L*(a) := {w ∈ Euclid P : there is a finset s of indices with m + 2 ≤ |s| and w_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ s}. Then for all x, y ∈ Euclid P with x_i − y_i ∈ ℤ for every i: infDist(x, L*(a)) ≤ √(m + 2)·κ(r(y)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P), (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ κ : (Fin P → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ u : Fin P → ℝ, ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, u i ≤ κ u) → ∀ x y : Euclid P, (∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, x i - y i = k) → infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} ≤ Real.sqrt (m + 2) * κ (fun j => max ((y j - a j) / (1 - a j)) ((a j - y j) / a j))
